snippet.title: Stolen Heart, the Magical Girl Deck Builder ✧ Teaser
snippet.description:
Hey there!
I'm super excited to share our new game teaser!

Stolen Heart is a Magical Girl Deck Builder where you choose your hero equipments and spells to beat the Dungeon. The Heart of Magic is guarded by the depths monsters. Become the strongest Magical Girl and follow the right path to retrieve it! ✨

If you want to support our project, you can wishlist Trinket Bag Maker on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4307530/Stolen_Heart/

Thank you so much and talk to you soon! ♥

- Follow me -
Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/lya.mgtt/
Twitter : https://twitter.com/Lya_Mgtt

- Video editing -
Adobe Premiere Pro
Panasonic Lumix GX880W
Nikon D3200
Procreate

- Credits -
